purpose: Bounded calibration; no V01 acceptance or numerical image-quality gates
jitter_definition: Halton bases 2 and 3, indices 1..32, minus 0.5, rounded to binary32; repeated without restarting motion
sample: pixel centres (x+0.5-jx,y+0.5-jy); one shared half-open rectangle hit for colour, depth and motion
cut: Camera translates in world XY by (192/focal,96/focal) at frame 37; focal=90/tan(fovY/2). Projected shifts: foreground (-96,+48), background (-24,+12) render pixels. Camera then remains fixed. Object motion and jitter keep absolute frame identity.
motion: Unjittered previousUV-currentUV of current visible surface; foreground (-0.375/320,-0.25/180) except frame 0 (zero) and camera cut; stationary background zero except cut (+24/320,-12/180). Cut foreground ((96-0.375)/320,(-48-0.25)/180). Reverse control negates foreground only.
quantization: double scene arithmetic -> binary32 -> existing native half(): truncate normal binary32 mantissa towards zero to binary16; no input subnormals; depth/exposure binary32. Decoder uses independent IEEE struct half conversion.

dispatch.reset: frame 0; additionally cut frame 37 in both cut arms only

references: Independent unjittered display point samples; exact rectangle/pixel overlap area coverage with constant FG/BG colours. Neither reference is a promised FSR output.
regions: Exclude outer 8 display pixels. Foreground/background interiors farther than 2 display pixels from silhouette; edges within 2; permanently visible background excludes entire swept rectangle for that sequence. Age 0,1,2..5 since last FG->BG visibility transition; also split silhouette distance <=2, (2,8], >8 display pixels. Empty samples are null with count zero.
measurements: RGB MAE, RMSE, p95 absolute error and maximum per frame/region/reference; residual difference at stationary BG and bilinearly reprojected FG using true (-0.75,-0.5) display flow, excluding camera-cut temporal pair; A t vs t+32; age/distance error and signed FG leakage outside 2-pixel edge band; cut history/fresh RGB/RGBA differences and exact inputs; repeat spread and paired control differences. No clipping.
payloads: Every executed frame: full tightly packed RGBA16F output, full input bytes in Colour/Depth/Motion/Exposure order, frame metadata and native submission/fence/debug observations. Lossless gzip packaging preserves decoded SHA256 and byte count. Failure payloads remain retained.
retention: Full payloads and verbose frame analyses are temporary local inputs to independent validation. Finalized attempts are compacted by default, including failures; outcomes, logs, identities, pooled measurements and selected examples remain. --retain-diagnostics keeps full local data for an explicit diagnosis. Exports always omit bulk calibration data. Old GPU images cannot be recovered from hashes; rerunning may differ with software or hardware.
failure: Missing/incomplete payload or metadata, nonfinite RGBA, any channel sentinel left, failed dispatch/close/signal/readback, fence not exactly 1 or device removal/debug errors prevent structural completion. No numerical image-quality threshold.
bounds: Input child 180s; each 301-frame matrix child 240s; existing per-fence 60000ms plus descendant-killing process watchdog. One submitted frame at a time. Resources retained until context destruction after all fences; fail-fast process exit on uncertain completion. No open parameter search.
analysis_bounds: Streaming frame pairs and region accumulators, not the whole image corpus in RAM; offline audit timeout 1200s. Payload size/runtime and native process working set/private memory sampled at retained-sequence peak and after cleanup; no general performance or in-flight claim.
